description: Android Fragment class 'DataFragment' that displays a list of DataItems received from a phone, including an internal adapter class 'DataItemAdapter' and a data model class 'Event'.

classes.name: DataItemAdapter
classes.description: Custom ArrayAdapter for displaying Event objects in a list, with view holder pattern for performance.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Data model class representing a list item with a title and text.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, initializes ListView and adapter, and sets up the view.

methods.name: appendItem
methods.description: Adds a new Event to the list and updates the UI.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Provides the view for each list item, reusing views with ViewHolder pattern.

methods.name: Event constructor
methods.description: Initializes an Event object with a title and text.
